scale_appropriateness.rationale: All addition samples maintain sums at or below ninety-five pesos, remaining well within the specified ceiling of one hundred pesos. All subtraction samples keep both the starting amount and amount spent as values below one hundred pesos, with starting amounts reaching eighty pesos maximum and spent amounts ranging from zero to forty pesos. Chosen amounts reflect realistic daily transactions at the grade level while remaining computationally manageable for Grade 1 mental arithmetic development.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The node demonstrates substantial variety across contexts, visual representations, amount ranges, and pedagogical framings. Contexts range across piggy banks, family gifts, pocket savings, direct purchases, and community shopping locations. Visual supports alternate between PesoMoney pictorial representations showing coin and bill denominations, and NumberLine numeric models. Amount combinations cover single-digit arithmetic, operations requiring careful counting, and several boundary-adjacent cases providing rich varied learning contexts.
